_note: Embargo & geheimhouding (DECLARATIVE CORE) — appended onto the bundled src/manifest.json by main.js::mergeManifestFragments (ADR-037). Index + detail pages for the geheimhoudingenregister and the configurable grounds list; schema refs BY SLUG (geheimhouding / geheimhouding-grond), never PascalCase. The geheimhoudingenregister index is the per-body overview (REQ-EMB-006). The awaiting-bekrachtiging KPI reads the declarative awaitingBekrachtigingCount aggregation; the OVERDUE narrowing (bekrachtigingDeadline < now) is computed in this view over the deadline column, because the aggregation filter DSL is equality-only (see fragment 65 aggregations _note). OUT-OF-CORE (imperative, not in this fragment): the impose/bekrachtig/opheffen dialogs (src/dialogs/*), the Dashboard stat widgets (mergePages replaces a same-id page wholesale, so a fragment cannot add a widget to the base Dashboard page without duplicating it), and the workflow action buttons wired to GeheimhoudingController routes.

pages.title: Confidentiality register
pages._note: spec: openspec/changes/embargo-geheimhouding/specs/embargo-geheimhouding/spec.md (REQ-EMB-006). Geheimhoudingenregister index — the per-body overview. Columns scope/ground/imposedBy/imposedByBody/imposedAt/lifecycle/bekrachtigingDeadline; quick filters on lifecycle. The awaiting-bekrachtiging workload is this index filtered to lifecycle=opgelegd; overdue (bekrachtigingDeadline in the past) is read off the deadline column (the declarative awaitingBekrachtigingCount aggregation counts opgelegd per body; the overdue narrowing needs a time predicate the aggregation filter cannot express). Geheimhouding records are authenticated-only (never public / ORI), so no public predicate applies.

pages.title: Confidentiality
pages._note: spec: openspec/changes/embargo-geheimhouding/specs/embargo-geheimhouding/spec.md (REQ-EMB-006 / REQ-EMB-007). GeheimhoudingDetail. Record data leads 8-wide (scope + target reference, imposedBy/imposedByBody/imposedAt, bekrachtiging + opheffing fields when set); the resolved ground (citation incl. legacyCitation), imposedByBody, target, bekrachtigingsbesluit and opheffingsbesluit render as resolved references in the data + Related widgets. Audit trail is a sidebar tab (REQ-EMB-007: the per-geheimhouding view-audit list of stukken under geheimhouding is queryable here for griffie/staff — the audit logging itself is imperative and out of this declarative fragment). The impose/bekrachtig/opheffen action buttons (wired to GeheimhoudingController) are the imperative tail and are NOT declared here.

widgets.title: Confidentiality status timeline
widgets._note: register-detail-optimisation REQ-EMB-010/011/012: fixed 3-stage lifecycle (imposed / bekrachtiging / opheffing) with pending/overdue states, resolved ground (citation + legacyCitation), and resolved target reference (targetDocument/targetAgendaItem/targetDecision).

pages.title: Confidentiality grounds
pages._note: spec: openspec/changes/embargo-geheimhouding/specs/embargo-geheimhouding/spec.md (REQ-EMB-002). Configurable grounds list — grounds are admin-editable DATA (add/edit/deactivate). Columns name/citation/legacyCitation/category/requiresBekrachtiging/active; quick filters on category and active. Deactivated grounds stay listed (and resolvable on old records) but the app-side ground picker excludes them for new geheimhoudingen (not expressible as a schema constraint).
